title: Air Products to Broadcast Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter Earnings Teleconference on November 5, 2026
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Air Products (NYSE:APD) will hold a conference call to discuss its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026...
body_markdown:
LEHIGH VALLEY, Pa.


, Oct. 6, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Air Products (NYSE:APD ) will hold a conference call to discuss its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. ET. The teleconference will be open to the public and the media in listen-only mode by telephone and Internet broadcast.


**APD Q4FY26 live teleconference:** 646-769-9200
**Passcode:** 7931867


**Internet broadcast/slides:** Available on the[Event Details](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790111-1&h=3742427911&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.airproducts.com%2Fevents%2Fevent-details%2Fq4-2026-air-products-earnings-conference-call&a=Event+Details) page on Air Products' Investor Relations website.


**Internet replay:** Available on the[Event Details](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790111-1&h=3742427911&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.airproducts.com%2Fevents%2Fevent-details%2Fq4-2026-air-products-earnings-conference-call&a=Event+Details) page on Air Products' Investor Relations website.


**About Air Products**
Air Products (NYSE:[APD](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790111-1&h=3464543162&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.airproducts.com%2Fstock-information&a=APD) ) is a world-leading industrial gases company in operation for over 85 years focused on serving energy, environmental, and emerging markets and generating a cleaner future. The Company supplies essential industrial gases, related equipment and applications expertise to customers in dozens of industries, including refining, chemicals, metals, electronics, manufacturing, medical and food. As the leading global hydrogen supplier, Air Products develops, engineers, builds, owns and operates some of the world's largest hydrogen projects. Through its sale of equipment businesses, the Company also provides turbomachinery, membrane systems and cryogenic containers globally.


Air Products had fiscal 2025 sales of $12.0 billion from operations in approximately 50 countries.
